The pra'min are a species of crustacean, a hive society devoted to the care of its solitary queen. Pra'min are grown to suit their allocated role. Genetic and physical alterations are made to create a suitable shell shape for their life ahead, whether soldier or labourer. For example, the shell of a komms pra'min is grown and sculpted to resemble a satellite dish, while all pra'min can hold a <c,34,33>Cho-Lok Device.

The Cho-Lok Suicide Device is actually a bomb with a particle of anti-matter at its core. This device is a last hope weapon for this militaristic race, used only when a cause is lost, and to prevent the enemy from gaining a prize.

The jakhari are an ancient race who once possessed a vast empire. They are a hardy race whose thick skin and slow, deliberate gait resembles their mental agility. jakhari are, in general, happy to serve and have formed a symbiotic relationship with the <c,34,33>doolan. <c,31,0>Jakhari do the physical <c,36,35>work <c,31,0>while the doolan do all the important cerebral work.

The doolan are the dominant race in the galaxy, a fact made more amazing by their physical weakness. They have traded their way to the top. Here in Kar Es-Taal, doolan occupy administrative positions organising the <c,34,33>jakhari <c,31,0>workforce. Not originating on this arid planet, they find it hard to cope with the heat. The doolans use a moisturising device called a <c,36,35>porta-spa <c,31,0>to keep their sensitive skin cool and moist in the desert sun.

A drug derived from a carnivorous fungus found only in the deserts of Kar-Naq, kirith <c,32,37>K2ThO <c,31,0>can be used in a variety of ways. The drug has found favour with many galactic governments as a form of population control due to the psychological addiction resulting from its extreme hallucinogenic properties. The galactic centre for kirith production is here on Kar-Naq. The only known side effect is extreme <c,36,35>obesity.<c,31,0>

Some <c,34,33>doolan <c,31,0>worship a mythical race of beings called the Kobrai. They are believed to be the `Architects of Reality' operating monumental pieces of machinery to weave the fabric of existence. Some evidence has been excavated in the sand oceans of the west suggesting Kobrai activity on this planet several millenia ago. <c,36,35>Pra'min <c,31,0>mythology paints the Kobrai as a force for evil, manipulating the universe with no thought for its inhabitants.

The most obese person in the city was the <c,34,33>doolan <c,31,0>Karanni L'Bajo Maccam<1,101>. He was alleged to be the leader of a black market <c,36,35>Kirith <c,31,0>smuggling operation using pra'min soldiers as his bodyguard. Evidence soon appeared to prove his innocence and to incriminate his assistant Midima K-Kuhl<1,121> who was accused of acting without Karanni's knowledge. Since his release from the Hub, Karanni has disappeared. His former mansion is empty. He seems to have left the planet.

All physical work in Kar Es-Taal is carried out by the jakhari. This means that, even though they are prohibited from carrying weapons, they can often be seen walking around carrying huge rivet guns and welding harnesses. <n>This is only a problem if these tools are acquired by rebellious jakhari and are used for violence.

The Militia are your friends. They are here to keep everyone safe. Citizens must co-operate with Militia officers at all times. Their primary objective is to restrict the use of <c,34,33>Kirith<c,31,0> and to imprison black market traders. <n>The Militia <c,36,35>Headquarters <c,31,0>are heavily fortified.

The Militia Headquarters are situated directly above the <c,34,33>Hub<c,31,0> correctional facility at the centre of Kar Es-Taal. <c,32,37>Rhino <c,31,0>squadron is based here. This heavily defended building is also surrounded by a waterway system that powers the city's rotation mechanism.

Formerly the machinery which turns Kar Es-Taal to face the sun, the Hub<3,24>, beneath the centre of the city, is now a penal colony. It is self-running. There are no guards or warders. The prisoners operate the huge machines in return for regular food parcels.

Kar Es-Taal was once famed for its nightlife. Parties used to literally shake the dust from the city walls. For our safety, the <c,36,35>Militia<c,31,0> have prohibitted unauthorised enjoyment and issue party licences. The only club to have an entertainment licence is the <c,34,33>Mojo Ladder.<c,31,0> This lucrative role is envied by many `business men' who would like to inherit the license if the current owner should suddenly die.

The Mojo Ladder<3,12> is the best club in the city. It is also the only authorised club in the city. This is the birthplace of the `Jakhari Jive' and, everyone's favourite, the `Doolan Dip'. <n>The club is owned and run by the mysterious and eccentric doolan Dah'Mon Targ<1,30> who will own the licence until his death.

The city of Kar Es-Taal is the most cosmopolitan on the planet Kar-Naq. Our unique situation, at the planet's extreme northern axis, and the continual <c,34,33>rotation<c,31,0> of the city make us a popular tourist destination. We are visited by travellers from numerous star systems for both business and pleasure. <n>A program of <c,36,35>construction<c,31,0> has been started, bringing new investment to the Cusp.

The city of Kar Es-Taal is unique because of its rotation. The whole city moves in concert with the sun which creates an interesting social structure. Part of the city is always in full sun. This area is known as the Golden Crescent. The opposite side of the city is in perpetual darkness. This region is called the Shades. The region in between is in constant twilight and is referred to as the Cusp.

Kar Es-Taal's Kirith inspired galactic prominence has resulted in increased public spending. Construction projects are commencing throughout the poorer parts of the city to re-develop them into tourist friendly entertainment zones. Work has already started in the Cusp. A militia operation has begun to clear unwanted elements from the streets. It is generally believed that organised crime controls this area.

As with any prosperous city, a Black Market has sprung up to exploit its wealth. Crime runs riot, despite the threat of imprisonment in the <c,34,33>Hub. <c,31,0>The most recent incident to which the underworld gangs can be linked is the assassination of Kar-Naq's Governor here in the city. Quaresh Pegh's murder is rumoured to have been ordered by the crimelord, Akim Quorta Khan. Despite an intense <c,36,35>Militia <c,31,0>hunt, this violent arms smuggler seems to have gone to ground.

All bow down before the vast majesty of Gulam Shu XXIII, Pontifex and supreme ruler of the Doolan Galactic State, hear his words...`All faithful <c,34,33>doolan <c,31,0>remember; your life is commerce, commerce is your life. The prosperity of the Doolan Empire is your foremost goal in life. Before family, before self. The doolan are the will and the way of the divine. The greater your profit, the greater his gift to you in the after-life.'

<c,34,33>Doolan <c,31,0>females are rare and treasured by their families. The large litters born to a female each year are necessary for the continuation of the doolan as a galactic power. <n>A female's well being is the main goal of her mate. A male's fertility must be assessed before marriage. Females are polygamous; a necessity for the survival of the species. <n><c,36,35>More<c,31,0>

The <c,34,33>jakhari <c,31,0>rebel movement and the Black Market are becoming an increasing threat within Kar Es-Taal. Cache's of ammunition have been found in the most unexpected of places. With the recent <c,36,35>Militia <c,31,0>clampdown on organised crime a reward is being given for information leading to the arrest of the terrorists and a munitions amnesty has been announced in order to clean the streets for the expected commencement of mass tourism in our fair city next year.

1. SHIELD CHARGER. These batteries have been a standard portable power supply for many years. Used to back-up the city's electricity grid, they can be used to power up any electrical item. <n>2. KIRITH PIPE. The main vehicle for Kirith abuse. The smoking of dried Kirith powder is the favoured intoxicant of the jakhari. <n>3. HYPO SPRAY. Extreme Kirith addicts use this system to inject liquid Kirith. Though painful, the effects of the drug are felt immediately. <n>                                                          <c,34,33>MORE.<c,31,0>

1. PORTA SPA. This is an essential item for a doolan. Without it their skin would crack and blister under the heat of the sun. <n>2. BACHELOR BEADS. Awarded by the local council and carried by all single male doolan, the beads indicate their potential as a suitor. Doolan males outnumber females a hundred to one. <n>3. DOOLAN SIDEARM. This phased plasma pistol is the favoured weapon of the doolan gentry due to its high power and efficiency.

<c,34,33>Jakhari <c,31,0>are asexual with each changing gender in a complex series of cycles. With long pregnancies and births always resulting in the death of the parent, the race is doomed. <n>Standing with one leg raised is illegal in the city since male jakhari find the odd pose totally irresistible and are driven to a frenzy of desire. <c,36,35>Doolan <c,31,0>laws on jakhari mating practices are designed to maintain the species and not, as rumoured, to propagate their slave status.
A membership card is what you need for me to let you in here. If you have to ask, I'll guess you don't have one!
Members<3,11> tend to carry their cards with them to prevent them being stolen.
The Mojo Ladder's the best nightclub in the City.
The Mojo Ladder's in the back streets<2,23> to the east.
A passport to a wild time at the Mojo Ladder<3,12> club.
A sign that you're a member<3,11> of the Mojo Ladder<3,12> club.
It's what you show the guard on the door of the Mojo Ladder<3,12> to get in.
A person with class. Someone on the A-list. B-Ehn<1,31> and Fle'Pah<1,29> are members.
A very lucky citizen. Membership is closed now.
Anyone might be a member. Both doolan and jakhari are accepted. Even some Militia guards are members.
They're an exclusive group. Members come from all over the city. I wouldn't know where to start.
He's a business man. He owns and runs the Mojo Ladder<3,12> nightclub and he demands respect.
Dah'Mon's a doolan<3,10>. He's the owner of the Mojo Ladder<3,12> club.
He's a Militia guard. I think he's stationed at the city gate.
B-Ehn is a member of the Militia.
He's the really tall Militia guard.
It's just a scrap of paper.
It looks like rubbish to me.
L-Hes is the bartender at the Mojo Ladder.<3,12>
He's the jakhari who works behind the bar at the Mojo Ladder.<3,12>
He works at the Mojo Ladder club. He's always short changing me!
He's my boss. He owns the place and doesn't he know it! Treat him with respect.
L-Hes is the fat, ugly jakhari working behind the bar.
He's behind the bar. Where would you expect the bartender to be?
Nice job, Blue. So that gun's not just for show. <n>My people will clean up the mess.
What about our agreement? I need information about the Carteele and Ul D-Grak.
The Carteele? %Hmmm. That doesn't ring any bells. I've never heard of it.
Perhaps this will jog your memory, fish-face.
%Aah. It's all coming back to me.
The Carteele is an illegal event that's held in the Hub<3,24>. Convicts fight robots to the death for a few moments of glory. The whole thing is televised but it's illegal to watch it!

I can't help you more than that. I don't know how to enter the Hub<3,24>. You will need to talk to Karanni L'Bajo Maccam<1,101> to learn anything more. He should be able to tell you about this `Ul D-Grak' character as well.
So where do I find him?
His mob operates from the Cusp. You'll need to take a train. I can't tell you anything more.
Don't waste your time threatening me. I'm more scared of them than I am of you. Watch out for Karanni's right hand man, Kol'Shee; he has ambitions of his own and could be dangerous.
Alright. But if you're lying to me, I'll be back!
He's a jakhari. I don't trust him though. He's always walking around the market square looking suspicious. I think he might be an anarchist<3,13>.
It's a place, not a person.
It's an exclusive club. Actually, I'm a member<3,11>.
It's a great nightclub. They lowered the tone when they let jakhari join, but I'm still a member<3,11>.
I'm a member of the Mojo Ladder.<3,12>
He hangs around the market place.
I don't like him. He's a bit dodgy.
He's the good looking guard next to me.
He's the tall, skinny guard on my right.
It's just a key to somebody's house.
What can I tell you? It's a key.
I don't recognise it but it's obviously a door key.
Anarchists are jakhari terrorists who don't agree with the rightful order of society. I think they're just lazy!
Anarchists should be called freedom fighters. They are trying to free the jakhari racefrom the yoke of doolan oppression.
A terrorist. They chain themselves to railings and blow up doolan property to draw attention to the `Jakhari Rights' movement.
Someone who is trying to break down order in society by using guns and explosives.
Some people think that they are everywhere. All around you. You never really know till the shooting starts.
It's hard to say who is an anarchist. Anyone you meet might be one.
Anarchists are just young jakhari looking for trouble.
A trouble-maker. They should all be shot.

Quiet. You never know who's listening. I'll help you, but you must help me first. A couple of jakhari thugs will arrive soon. They're running a protection racket<3,14> and want money. You could use that big gun of yours to end their scam.<7,1>
Nice gun. If you pull your gun on me, you have to be able to use it.
Don't be stupid. You might need me later.
Ooooh. You're scaring me. <n>Now go away before I lose my temper.
Thugs trying to scare businesses into giving them money or they smash the place up.
At the Mojo Ladder club, I think.<3,12>
It's easy money. It's what my colleague and I do.
You don't know? You haven't heard of Akim Quorta Khan? He's taking over `business' in this city.
A neurotoxin is a very powerful poison which attacks the nervous system and causes a quick, but painful death.
It's a nasty chemical weapon which paralyses and then kills.
Most of Rhino squadron. I see you finished the two I missed.
We have to reach the %Time Slider<3,18>. <n>The militia are holding it in hangar 18. Follow me.
Wait a minute. What's a Time Slider?
%They're strange creatures which can travel through space and time. This one will take us to your target.
That's all you need to know for now. Let's go!
It's the building where the Militia are stationed.
That's where the Militia patrols come from.
It's a dangerous place, that's what.
It's not a safe place. You want to keep away from there. They shoot first and ask questions later.
Right in the centre of the city; directly over the Hub<3,24>.
It's in the middle of Kar Es-Taal, surrounded by canals.
Listen for the Militia guns, you'll soon find it!
This is the entrance to the Militia Headquarters. Now go away or it'll be the last thing you ever see!

Actually, my father used to oversee the Jakhari drain cleaners at the H.Q. He worked there all his life. He thought the place would fall apart when he retired. He used to sneek me in through the maintenance tunnels<3,16> when I was a child.

Not many people know about the maintenance tunnels. They run from the canals right into the heart of the Militia H.Q. All of the drains empty into them. They're not very well defended because of the smell.
You'll need to get through the gate<3,33> behind those guards first and then get into the canal. After that, just follow your nose. They are defended, though. Look out for gun turrets!
He's the jakhari waiting tables. He's not fast, but he's cheap.
It's the door to Hangar 18. They keep the evidence in there! Evidence of life from other dimensions!
It's the only way to get into Hangar 18.

The doolan official I killed owned the key. It may still be on his body if you can find it. There wasn't much left when I'd finished with him, though. They may have used the KrimeKleen evidence vaccuum<0,37> to clear the site.
To the left of my cell. It's next to the lever which opens the bars, actually.
It's a large blue vaccuum cleaner the militia use to gather scene of crime evidence. They sort through everything later.
I don't know. I've been stuck in this cell for months. How am I supposed to know? Look for it!
There's one being held in Hangar 18 behind the sealed door<3,17>. We must get through the door.
It's situated in the maximum security zone of the Militia Headquarters.<3,15>
Don't hurt me or I'll never help you. I'd be putting myself in danger so you'll have to make it worth my while. Bring me something valuable and I'll take you there.<8>
Oh dear. You threatening me? Nobody threatens ME!<7,6><8>
He's a short doolan with a serious attitude problem.
He's a doolan. He thinks he's important.
Don't trust him. He's a psycho.
He's a doolan. <n>Everybody pushes him around.
He thinks he's some kind of boss.
He's just this guy, you know.
Hold fast, <n> <n>  Serious re-adjustments to the Space-Time continuum are under way.......
SaveGame data incompatible with this version.
He's probably at the Mojo Ladder club.<3,12>
You should be careful who you talk to about Karanni. He's dangerous and he has many friends. You could get seriously hurt.
Karanni's a very powerful `business man'. He has a lot of influence around here.
He's someone you don't want to upset.
Karanni L'Bajo Maccam is a local `business man'. He looks after the doolan around here. He wouldn't hurt anyone unless they deserved it!
You are out of your depth. Karanni's the man who'll reward me for ripping your blue skin off!<7,6><8>
Don't EVER point a gun at me.<7,6><8>
He's the gate man at Karanni L'Bajo Maccam's private mansion.
I think he's the doolan who runs the guard at Karanni L'Bajo Maccam's place.
He's a very private person. He also works very hard.
Ah! You'd be surprised how many people would like to know where Karanni is. I can't help you.
He's just a business man, nothing unusual; nothing sinister.
Look, I can't help you so just go away.
It's no use whining. There's nothing for you here.
You won't get around me that way! I have nothing to say.
Don't push your luck, stranger. You don't know what you're meddling with.
Might I suggest you put that gun down, you are upsetting my associates.
You ask too many questions and I don't like your tone.
I don't know anything about him. Leave me alone. I don't want any trouble. You don't know what he does to people who talk too much!<7,3><8>
Oh, he gets on my nerves. He's got no backbone that jakhari runt.
What a little wimp. He's always running away from trouble.
He's a waste of a good skin.
It looks like kirith spores in a liquid suspension. It's the cheapest form of the drug.
It's a flask of kirith. They fill hypodermics from this sort of jar.
It's kirith, but it's a very weak solution.
He'll be in his audience chamber. He has to be immersed in kirith because of his addiction.
Okay, it's downstairs. I'll unbolt the door. Come in and collect it but you'll need a key.<0,49><7,1>
It's mine and you can't have it!
He's my boss. I do all of his paper work. <n>I'm very important you know. I even have my own key to his apartment!<0,49> He keeps the door bolted from the inside for extra security.
He'll be in his apartment. He spends most of his time out on his balcony keeping an eye on things.
Fle'Pah<1,29> is a very important doolan. Kar Es-Taal would grind to a halt without him. He sends memos!
He's a very lowly doolan office worker.
He's my private secretary. He helps me with my very important work.
It's my key to Fle'Pah<1,29>'s apartment.
It's the key to my apartment.
It's an instruction leaflet for some high-tech packing equipment.
It shows the activation code for a special compression tool.
Midima used to work for Karanni.
He's a particularly nasty jakhari. He's serving time in the Hub<3,24>.
Midima's a thug, and he surrounds himself with thugs.
It's some gold coins. You use them to buy things.
Stolen you say? I don't know anything about that.
What is this? Some sort of militia entrapment scam?
You've never heard of cash? You use it in exchange for goods or services.
Bhug-Zsee<1,103> and Moog-Zsee<1,104> stole it from me. I don't know which of them has it now
It's mine. The muggers stole it from me.
I don't know what you're talking about. Leave me alone.
He's a thug. He picks on people smaller than himself and robs them in the streets.
He's the type of character who gives the jakhari a bad name.
He's a doolan. Everyone around here picks on him. He's practically a professional victim.
He's the little doolan. If you see someone being mugged, chances are it's him.
I don't know what you're talking about.
Brown rats are quite common in the Hub, but very difficult to catch because they are so quick. The Holy Book commands us not to eat their flesh since they are vermin.
The prisoners in the Hub like to eat rats.
Okay, you've proved yourself. <n>I'll let you into the Carteele arena.
Remember, this is being broadcast live to the city so put on a good show.
Don't expect to survive. The arena guard robots are armed and very enthusiastic.
What am I supposed to do?
The arena is split into four separate sections. You must recover a key from each one.
The order in which you tackle the zones is up to you, but the door will close behind you on entry and you can't leave a zone until you have found the hidden key.
If you can find all four keys, then you will be the champion. <n>No one has survived this ordeal for three years but then, I didn't say it was easy.
It was nice knowing you. <n>Hurry now, the audience will get restless.
I really can't tell you anything or the others will punish me.
Please don't ask me. They'll kill me if I say anything.
Don't kill me! He's in his underground lair<3,19>.
It's below the demolition site. There's a trapdoor hidden here somewhere, but it's locked. You'll have to blow it open.
He's a powerful doolan. Everyone's scared of him.
It's Mr Kahn's home. He lives there with his elite guard. They say he has a bath full of kirith down there!
It's through this door, but you'll have to bring me a trophy<3,21> before I'll let you in.
She's a scary lady and certainly knows how to use a gun. She's not from this planet, in fact she looks a bit like your species.
She's waiting in the winner's enclosure for someone. I told her not to hold her breath but, whoever she's waiting for, she thinks he'll have no problem surviving the Carteele.
Well, she's not from around here. That's for sure.
All sorts of things are good to eat.
Everyone likes different things. Prisoners in the Hub like rats.
Things to eat can be found in all sorts of odd places.
A trophy is something which was owned by a victim of yours. If you don't have anything, you could always find me something good to eat.<3,20>
He's a slimy little jakhari who sticks his nose into everybody's business. He'll get himself killed one day.
Something special you've taken from someone. A doolan's bachelor beads would be a good trophy.
All sorts of things are good to eat. Midima is especially fond of baked rat<0,55>.
There aren't many around here, Pav-Lov<1,140> sees to that. When you do see one the things move so fast they're hard to catch.
He's the most important prisoner in the Hub<3,24>. He's in charge of the Carteele.<3,29>
It's held in the Arena. Midima K-Kuhl<1,121> organises the whole thing.
It's a suicide device used by pra'min soldiers to evade capture.
I think that's a place, not a person.
My supervisor is a doolan. He ran off when the pra'min<3,2> attacked us. I think he might be hiding by the city gate.<2,2>
No, wait. We can use him.
He works for Karanni L'Bajo Maccam.
I'm Ul D-Grak. You've been looking for me. My real name is K L'Hanna.
I'm impressed with your abilities. You're good with a gun. My associates and I have a `job' for you. There is someone we need you to kill, but it's an unusual job.
I'll give you more details when we reach our destination, but for now I must keep some things secret. You'll have to trust me.
Trust you? I don't know anything about you or these mysterious `colleagues' of yours.
You will be well rewarded if you succeed. I know that you have lost your memory. I can help you remember.
I have travelled a long way and been through a lot to get this far.
I might as well finish the job now.
Good. We have to reach a hangar at the heart of the Militia Headquarters<3,15>. You must find a way into the building and open the main gates for me to join you. I know the route to the hangar.
They are holding something there; something we need to reach our destination and your target.
